title: Say It Clearly: Pronunciation for Biology Words
objective: Students learn stress, syllables, and slow practice for common biology terms.
context: Practice words from a plant class: biology, microscope, leaf.

items.prompt: Say the first word in parts. Say it again with the stressed part louder.
Say the second word slowly. Ask a partner to repeat it.
items.answer: Listen for first-syllable stress in microscope; accept clear pronunciation across accents.
items.hint: Say the whole word once before your partner speaks.

items.prompt: Use the last word in a short spoken sentence.
